Summary BlackRock Capital Allocation Term Trust announced a rights offering with a conservative 1-for-5 ratio and a 98.5% NAV floor. The subscription price is set at 95% of market price, capped at $0.01 below NAV, minimizing dilution to a worst-case ~-0.25%. BCAT's premium compressed sharply post-announcement, highlighting the risk of holding CEFs at elevated premiums ahead of offerings. I recommend subscribing only if BCAT's discount is narrower than -1.5% at expiry; otherwise, buying shares on the open market is preferable. Looking for a helping hand in the market?
